:::{#def-mgf}
#### Moment generating function

The **moment generating function** of a [random variable](random-variables.qmd#def-random-variable) $X$
is the [function](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/functions.html#def-function) $M_X$
of a [real number](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/number-systems.html#def-real-numbers) $t$
that gives the [expectation](expectation.qmd#def-expectation) of $\ef{tX}$,
defined at every $t$ with $\E{\ef{tX}} < \infty$:

$$M_X(t) \eqdef \E{\ef{tX}}$$

:::
